notes: Single whole-Gemeinde calendar, no district/Bezirk split (label_set.json lists only town 'Baierbrunn'), so no district choice was needed. Each day carries a plain-text label directly ('Restmüll', 'Biomüll', etc.), not a letter code, printed in a coloured band; the bottom legend maps each colour to its label. Two days in the window are combined pickups printed as 'Sperrmüll/Restmüll' (2026-02-26) and 'Sperrmüll/Restmüll' (2026-09-10, spelled the same though the legend swatch calls the colour 'Sperrmüll/Christbaumabh./Aktionen'); both dates were added to both 'rest' and 'sperr'. 'Gartenabfälle' is recorded as 'gruen' per the protocol's Grünschnitt/Gartenabfälle/Christbaum wording, and the single 'Christbaumabh.' day (2026-01-10, also mentioned by name on page 1's Abfall-ABC as the FWW Baierbrunn pickup on 10.01.2026) was recorded under 'gruen' for the same reason. 'Giftmobil' (a mobile hazardous-waste collection point, visiting monthly) is recorded as 'schadstoff'. A pink band marks 'Schulferien' on many other days; it carries no bin label and was not counted. All dates cross-checked against the given 2026-01-01=Thursday anchor for the printed weekday and matched. Read from 300dpi crops of the September/October block and the a1/a2/b1/c1 page tiles; the whole PDF is a native vector/text calendar, not scanned, so text was crisp throughout.
